items.title: Hackers steal $3.6 million from crypto ATM giant Bitcoin Depot
items.description: Bitcoin Depot, which operates one of the largest Bitcoin ATM networks, says attackers stole $3.665 million worth of Bitcoin from its crypto wallets after breaching its systems last month. [...]

items.title: Microsoft Suspends Developer Accounts of High-Profile Open-Source Projects
items.description: Microsoft has suspended the Windows Hardware Program developer accounts of two critical open-source security projects, VeraCrypt and WireGuard, blocking their ability to sign drivers and push updates to millions of Windows users, with no prior warning or explanation provided to the developers. items.title: New RoningLoader Campaign Uses DLL Side-Loading and Code Injection to Evade Detection
items.description: A threat actor known as DragonBreath has launched a stealthy campaign using a multi-stage malware loader called RoningLoader. The malware targets Chinese-speaking users by disguising itself as trusted software such as Google Chrome and Microsoft Teams. Its core strength lies in a layered approach to avoiding detection — combining DLL side-loading, code injection, and signed […] The post New…

items.title: Critical Chrome Vulnerabilities Let Attackers to Execute Arbitrary Code
items.description: Google has released Chrome 147 to the stable channel for Windows, Mac, and Linux, patching a sweeping set of security vulnerabilities — including two critical-severity flaws that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on targeted systems. The most severe vulnerabilities in this release are CVE-2026-5858 and CVE-2026-5859, both carrying a Critical severity rating […] The post…

items.title: Microsoft suspends dev accounts for high-profile open source projects
items.description: Microsoft has suspended developer accounts used to maintain multiple high-profile open-source projects without proper notification and no way to quickly reinstate them, effectively blocking them from publishing new software builds and security patches for Windows users. [...]

items.title: Russia's Forest Blizzard Nabs Rafts of Logins Via SOHO Routers
items.description: Heard of fileless malware? How about malwareless cyber espionage? Russia's APT28 is spying on global organizations by modifying just one DNS setting in vulnerable routers.
